---
Product and Operations each get one explicit question in its own section, in plain language, with no implementation detail. Anything else aimed at them is a separate cut.

**how to check:** a Product/Ops section with more than one question, or with technical vocabulary, fails. A claim that "the doc asks Product exactly one question" holds only if the section shows that.
